selection: All Ordnance Survey Open Names cities, towns, villages, hamlets and other settlements in Great Britain, supplemented by OSNI towns/villages and GeoNames populated places in Northern Ireland. No population cutoff for named places; suburban-area-only names, historical/deserted places and individual properties are excluded. Census populations remain attached to their whole statistical areas; newly added named places have no inferred population. Greater London uses one London marker; boroughs and the City of London remain administrative selections.
